entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: A small fortified island nation in the Lat-Nam Straits on Terisiare, ruled by Lady Edara, engulfed by the Great Glacier.

entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: Nation across the strait from Jehesic ruled by Lord Peemel.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Lady of Jehesic, known for her beauty and defiance of Peemel.

entities.name: Peemel
entities.description: Lord of Iwset who declared war when Edara refused to marry him.

entities.name: Ferantia
entities.description: Edara's treacherous sorceress who betrayed her and was slain by Apepei.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Dwarven lover of Edara who slew Ferantia and Digody.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Peemel's advisor who assassinated him and was killed by Apepei.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Peemel's heir who refused the throne.

entities.name: Offero
entities.description: Figure who contested Edara and Apepei's claim to Iwset.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: The advance of ice that engulfed Jehesic.

events.summary: Lord Peemel of Iwset declares war on Jehesic after Lady Edara refuses to marry him.
events.quote: When she refused, Peemel declared war.

events.summary: Jehesic's sorceress Ferantia betrays Edara but is slain by Edara's secret lover Apepei.
Jehesic sinks Iwset's navy and captures its general, Ihesia.
events.quote: Jehesic sank Iwset's navy and captured its general

events.summary: Peemel kidnaps Edara but is assassinated by his advisor Digody; Apepei kills Digody.
events.quote: Peemel kidnapped Edara, but was assassinated by his advisor Digody

events.summary: With Yunnie refusing the throne, Edara and Apepei forge an uneasy union of Jehesic and Iwset.
events.quote: Edara and Apepei forged an uneasy union of Jehesic and Iwset
the advance of the Great Glacier eventually engulfed the island nation
